ValidationRule.description: When both hours are set, End must be strictly later than Start. Blocks a transposed pair (e.g. 17 to 9) and an equal pair (9 to 9) that would otherwise fail silently. Overnight windows crossing midnight are not supported.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: End Hour must be later than Start Hour (for example, Start 9 and End 17). Overnight windows that cross midnight are not supported. To run at all hours, leave both Start Hour and End Hour blank.
